title: Natural transformation packaging the etale proper-open scalar map
statement:
Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\phi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes with compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-ring module sheaves on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Put $F_{R,c}=Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ for $R=A,B$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and let $S_T$ be derived scalar extension along $\phi$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension]. Define the natural transformation
$$q_{\phi,c}:S_YF_{A,c}\longrightarrow F_{B,c}S_X$$
by $q_{\phi,c}(M)=b_{c,M}$, where $b_{c,M}$ is the canonical proper/open scalar map of [def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps]: first take the proper scalar mate at $j_{!,A}M$, then $Rp_{*,B}$ of the open scalar isomorphism. This is the natural-transformation packaging of those specified components, with their naturality, and has no coefficient finiteness, flatness, boundedness or invertibility hypothesis.
